name: Age Discrimination
overview: Scripture teaches that God created all people in His image, affirming the inherent dignity of every individual regardless of age (Genesis 1:27). The Lord instructs His servants not to dismiss youthfulness as a limitation, calling them to speak His words faithfully (Jeremiah 1:7). The New Testament emphasizes that God shows no partiality or favoritism among people (Acts 10:34; Romans 2:11) and calls believers to love their neighbors as themselves (Mark 12:31). In Christ, distinctions such as ethnicity, social status, and gender are set aside, highlighting the unity and equal value of all members of the body of Christ (Galatians 3:28). This foundation challenges any form of discrimination, including that based on age, affirming the equal worth and calling of every believer.
